prompts.card:
Create ONE finished YUNIPALS collectible card as a 1024 x 1536 PNG, portrait 2:3, with genuine transparent exterior.
Reference #1 supplies the SPECIFIC OG Yunifairy CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY. The exact OG Yunifairy: a hovering small rounded pony-fairy with swept curled magenta forelock and mane, large golden-brown eyes with prominent golden-yellow lashes, two large butterfly wings with purple/pink panels and yellow scalloped edges and circular spots, a yellow star pendant at the chest, and four short dangling legs with yellow cuffs and small magenta toes. Preserve the OG face, mane, butterfly wing shapes, star pendant, hover pose and body proportions; do not make it a humanoid fairy.
Reference #2 is the APPROVED LOCKED CARD DESIGN. Copy its exact lavender frame, purple typography, official logo placement, polished clean 3D illustration quality, composition scale and finish policy. Its dragon is only a style example; the new character must be the specific monster in reference #1.
Reference #3 is the OFFICIAL FLAT YUNIPALS LOGO. Preserve its recognizable pink badge, dark outlined pale-gold face, green eye and mint fins exactly.

TRAITS: Type Yunifairy; main body color Purple; horn Diamond; glitter Yes.
Preserve the OG monster's face, eyes, body shape, markings, distinctive fins/mane/wings, proportions and stance. Recolor its PRIMARY skin to unmistakable PURPLE, retaining recognizable complementary markings and natural eye colors. Keep clothing, eyewear and anatomical features from the OG identity. Forehead horn: exactly one elongated translucent faceted DIAMOND crystal horn, crisp flat planes, no spiral grooves, naturally attached and clearly visible. No extra unicorn horns.
Use crisp dimensional colored surfaces with clean edges and readable form shading, as in the locked design. No blurry eyes, soft-focus body, dense speckles, frosted coating or glowing body outline.
FINISH: GLITTER YES: a few tiny isolated mineral glints on the shoulder, chest or tail; keep the face, eye and silhouette clean. The background and lavender frame have the approved prismatic holographic sheen, diagonal rainbow streaks and a few crisp painted stars. No frosted glitter blanket, rainbow dust, haze, grain or blurry body.

SCENE: meadow-purple: cheerful rolling green hills, soft clouds and a small distant windmill, with a gentle purple accent in the wildflowers; preserve the approved meadow landmarks. Replace reference #1's lunar/rocky setting completely. One full-body monster, naturally grounded or hovering if that is its OG stance. Fit its complete horn, wings/fins, feet and tail inside the art window.
FRAME: identical signature soft polished LAVENDER #c7c9f9 frame for every body color; grape-purple #7e22ce inner outlines and accents, pale white/lavender header and bottom nameplate. Never recolor the frame to match the creature. Follow the approved reference's rounded silhouette, proportions and thin inset details.
Exact top text: YUNIPALS. Exact bottom text: YUNIFAIRY. Bold chunky Archivo Black-style grape-purple lettering, centered and fully legible. Put the supplied official flat pink logo at the top-left header as in the approved design. These are the ONLY words. No level, number, rarity badge, stats, extra captions or invented text.
Keep the complete border with equal small transparent margins on all four sides, clean rounded corners, no exterior drop shadow or halo, and no visible canvas-edge pixels. This is a single premium card in the locked design, not a layout comparison.
